Maya: Need final lock on run-of-show + registration routing for the APAC-friendly webinar (Thu). Can we confirm by EOD PT?
Anya: Yes. We're doing a 2pm SGT / 3am PT slot so ops can run a parallel rehearsal in our timezone. Speakers: Sam (bench), Priya (customer), Leo (demo). Greenroom 13:30 SGT.
Sam: New idea: run a short A/B benchmark narrative in the first 6m. A: cost-first storytelling. B: latency-first storytelling. We'll show both decks in separate slides and call out the same dataset/prompt so it's apples-to-apples.
Priya: Customer vignette will be condensed for APAC audience; 90s with regional metrics. Uploading bullets now.
Leo: Ops plan: pre-warm 7m, run KV priming sequence, then demo two sequences. If p95 > 450ms trigger auto-failover to hosted small model `rw-lite-2026` and show a speaker slide explaining the fallback.
Leo: Rehearsal endpoint (ops):
```
curl -X POST https://rehearse.redwood-infer/api/run \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-bench-2026","mode":"prime","input":"Prime: summarize in 10 words"}'
```
Anya: Proposed run-of-show (SGT):
- 13:30 greenroom (speakers + ops)
- 13:50 intro (Maya) 2m
- 13:52 A/B benchmark mini (Sam) 6m (A then B)
- 13:58 demo (Leo) 10m (cost-opt, latency-opt)
- 14:08 customer vignette (Priya) 5m
- 14:13 live Q&A (panel) 12m
- 14:25 CTAs + lead-routing callouts (Ben) 5m
Ben: Lead routing plan: HubSpot form includes hidden fields: `utm=apac_launch`, `interest=demo|bench|nurture`, `enterprise_review=yes|no`, `timezone=auto`. Routing rules: if `interest=demo` -> tag `priority-demo` + push to #sales-intake; if `bench` -> label `bench-inquiry` and CSV export to Growth for benchmarking follow-up. Also capture `preferred_contact_time`.
Sam: For transparency, include a footnote slide showing dataset name + prompt template used for both A/B runs.
Priya: I'll upload the regional metrics slide and 90s bullets by 4pm SGT.
Anya: Rehearsal schedule: two short rehearsals tomorrow to cover both live and APAC-timed sims: 30-min full run at 09:00 PT and a quick 20-min handoff at 07:00 SGT. Invite sent. Speakers must upload slides to drive by 06:00 PT tonight.
Leo: Ops fallback commands for quick switch: `kubectl scale deployment=rw-bench --replicas=0` then hit hosted endpoint `https://api.redwood-infer/hosted/run?model=rw-lite-2026`. We'll keep a short explanation slide for transparency.
Ben: Post-webinar automation: trial leads -> auto-enroll 1:1 SDR outreach (high priority); bench leads -> email with benchmark artifacts + invite to deep-dive. Also trigger Slack summary to #sales-intake with CSV attached.
Maya: Small copy ask: CTA should mention "APAC session recording + optional trial". Ben, can you draft two CTA variants (trial-first, recording-first) and drop them here?
Ben: Draft A (trial-first): "Request a hands-on trial tailored to your workload  seats are limited".
Ben: Draft B (recording-first): "Watch the APAC session recording and get a benchmark pack".
Maya: Nice. We'll A/B the CTA in the post-registration flow for the first 200 signups. Ben: implement hidden `cta_variant=A|B`.
deploy-bot: Calendar invites created and rehearsal invites sent to speakers + ops.
Anya: One last ask: confirm the exact priming prompts in the slides footnote for auditability. Once slides + HubSpot fields are verified we lock the run.
Maya: Great work. If uploads + field checks finished by 6pm PT we lock. Thanks!
